add_namespace = COLDWAR_DEAL

# IMPERIA COLD WAR — 24.11.2026: deals from focus trees need the other country to agree (offer event, like MD).
# Generated by E:/HOI4_Mod_Tools/mdcoldwar/development/tools/deal_offers/wrap_offers.py; edit the generator, not this file.

country_event = { # COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit: offer to RAJ
	id = COLDWAR_DEAL.1
	title = COLDWAR_DEAL.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_DEAL_offer_desc
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DEAL_sign
		trigger = { FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_offered } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 0.2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < -25 } }
			modifier = { factor = 3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 49 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DEAL.1 option a"
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_offered
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_accepted
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DEAL.2 days = 1 }
			effect_tooltip = {
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = SER modifier = COLDWAR_EGY_positive_25 }
				add_opinion_modifier = { target = RAJ modifier = COLDWAR_EGY_positive_25 }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = RAJ }
				set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = FROM.id }
				set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = RAJ.id }
				set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
				}
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EGY_outlook_id = 3 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EGY_outlook_amount = 0.05 }
				COLDWAR_EGY_change_outlook_popularity = yes

			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DEAL_refuse
		trigger = { FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_offered } }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DEAL.1 option b"
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_offered
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_refused
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OFFER.1 days = 1 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_OFFER_lapsed
		trigger = { NOT = { FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit_RAJ_offered } } }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}

country_event = { # COLDWAR_EGY_na_the_brioni_spirit: RAJ signed, the deal takes effect for the initiator
	id = COLDWAR_DEAL.2
	title = COLDWAR_DEAL_signed_t
	desc = COLDWAR_DEAL_signed_desc
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DEAL_signed_a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DEAL.2 option a"
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = SER modifier = COLDWAR_EGY_positive_25 }
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = RAJ modifier = COLDWAR_EGY_positive_25 }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = RAJ }
		set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = ROOT.id }
		set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = RAJ.id }
		set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EGY_outlook_id = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_EGY_outlook_amount = 0.05 }
		COLDWAR_EGY_change_outlook_popularity = yes

	}
}

		if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase > 1 } check_variable = { cwgg_u_phase < 5 } } custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_ubias_5_2
		hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { cwgg_u_bias_5 = 2 } } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_ucons_eng_15
		hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_fpb_eng = 15 } } }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_GER_1970_tt_ucons_fra_5
		hidden_effect = { hidden_effect = { add_to_variable = { cwgg_fpb_fra = 5 } } } }

	desc = COLDWAR_DEAL_offer_desc
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_DEAL_sign
		trigger = { FROM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_POL_army_ai3_SOV_offered } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 0.2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < -25 } }
			modifier = { factor = 3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 49 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_DEAL.37 option a"
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_POL_army_ai3_SOV_offered
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DEAL_COLDWAR_POL_army_ai3_SOV_accepted
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DEAL.38 days = 1 }
			effect_tooltip = {
				set_temp_variable = { temp_opinion = 10 }
				change_the_military_opinion = yes
				if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
				swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_1
				}
				}
				else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
				swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_2
				}
				}
				else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4 NOT = { COLDWAR_POL_church_floor = yes } }
				swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_3
				}
				}
				else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5 }
				swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_4
				}
				}
				else_if = {
				limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6 }
				swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_6
				add_idea = COLDWAR_POL_brezhnev_doctrine_5
				}
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = { localization_key = modifies_dynamic_modifier_tt MODIFIER = COLDWAR_POL_army_modifier }
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_POL_mil_army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 tooltip = army_personnel_cost_multiplier_modifier_tt }
				newline = yes
				if = {
				limit = { 115 = { is_owned_and_controlled_by = FROM } }
				115 = {
				add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 2
				add_building_construction = { type = arms_factory level = 2 instant_build = yes }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.008 } }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
				add_tech_bonus = {
				name = COLDWAR_POL_army_ai3_tb
				bonus = 0.50
				uses = 2
				category = CAT_tanks
				}

			}
		}
	}
	option = {
